Name: Statesman's Longbow
Description:
A bow that shoots arrows of light at incredible speed.

Hold the input to ready the bow and press button to loose an arrow toward the aiming reticle. Aim by moving the camera.

You can also move while aiming.

Hold button to increase the power of the shot.

This ancient forma was created by Einar, a revenant who once ruled the country. Simple and versatile, it was passed down through generations. Einar was known for his occasionally relentless rule and is said to have fired upon disobedient citizens from his palace window.

Name: Battle Axe: Idris's Conceit
Description:
A special axe that generates a temporal force field. Striking with the axe creates a wide-area shock wave. The axe's swing can easily break through shields, and its force field gradually builds up the slow status ailment.

One of many formae crafted by Progenitor Idris. It is unknown if its name was meant as an admonishment of Idris himself or as a warning to the user.

Name: Bloodreaver Blade
Description:
A long blade that slashes foes with a flash-draw strike. Hold button to enter a ready stance. Release to perform a slash draw. The timing of the release affects both motion and power. A well-timed release delivers a significantly stronger blow.

This forma was devised by Astolfo, founder of the Anjou House of the Gula Bloodline. On the battlefield, he built mountains of corpses, his greatsword feared as the Bloodreaver, and he himself revered as a god of war.

Name: Absolute Executioner
Description:
An executioner's sword wreathed in spinning gears and sparking blades. Unleashes a multi-hit downward strike. Hold button to increase the number of hits.

This forma was created by Gregory, founder of McLeish House and once an executioner himself. Its dreadful, machine-like shape of interlocking blades reflects his severity as a servant of the law. The crushing force of a single strike is said to carry a grim mercy for the condemned.

Name: MK Rosenritter
Description:
Twin triple-barreled Gatling guns that turn a wide area into a bullet storm.

Ready the gun and move the camera to aim, then fire by pressing button. You can also move while aiming. Sustains continuous fire as long as the button is held and ichor remains.

This forma was crafted by Bella, the most gifted daughter of Asturias House of the Luxuria Bloodline. Bella surrounded herself with beautiful retainers known as the Rose Knights, who served as her guards. Though elegant in appearance, the forma bestowed upon them possesses unparalleled destructive power. A perfect embodiment of the saying, "Every rose has its thorn," it remains a cherished weapon for the women of Asturias House.

Name: Warhammer of the Fool
Description:
A fire-belching hammer with three forms. Initiates a chain of attacks starting from a heavy downward swing.

After use, hold button and press button: Trigger a two-hit combo.
After combo, hold button and press button, button, or button: Trigger a unique finisher move.

The finisher changes depending on which additional button is pressed.

This forma is wielded by the peerless savant, Zenon Gryfgote. Though Zenon created countless advanced formae and commands them as effortlessly as breathing, this particular forma is surprisingly not his own. It is a relatively mundane forma passed down throughout the Acedia Bloodline that he merely borrowed, perhaps evidence that Zenon sees combat itself as no more than a trivial pursuit.

Name: Manus Rapacis
Description:
A grotesque hand that channels the Resurgence's power into a searing beam of light. Fires a long-range laser directly ahead in a straight line. While firing, you can use mouse to adjust the beam's direction.

This forma captures a fragment of the power of the hero Valentin. The hand, shaped by his yearning for the future, reaches into the void, but what is it hoping to grasp?

Name: Wings of Eternity
Description:
The twisted wings of Valentin, transfigured into forma. Rains countless spears of light from above, bombarding a wide area.

These corrupted wings of the dragon who bore the world's sins now shine with the power to purify immortal souls.

Name: Sword of Karma: Idris
Description:
A massive sword, in which dwells the fires of pathos.

Swing the blade with great force to deliver two consecutive strikes.

Press button during the action to perform another combo strike, then button to branch into a finisher. (Consumes ichor on use.)

The favorite sword of Progenitor Idris, which served him well throughout his life. It bears the name of the great hero and demonstrates power befitting such an accomplished and renowned figure, but it had not always housed such power. The blade, as well as the formae woven throughout the sword, were honed over unfathomable years as Idris traveled through time over and over again. The sheer might of this forma speaks to just how harsh the great hero's journey was.

Name: Edge of Days Gone
Description:
A unique axe, in which dwells the fires of pathos.

Forma-spawned bats fire lasers in multiple directions.

Hold button while starting the action to change it into a high-power slam attack.

Created when the bequeathed forma wielded by Lou was corrupted by the intense pathos that made up the Forsaken World. Amplifies the bearer's pathos to its absolute limit, transforming it into raw power.

The immense energy surging through this weapon is proof that the heart has a sway over the fate of this world—even if what lies within is an unrequited yearning for a time that is never to return.
